ideas.pitch: A fully functional web auditing tool that runs real-time code checks and generates compliance risk reports within a 12-hour build window.
ideas.title: WebFlow Audit Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: It provides genuine engineering utility and strict adherence to the 12-hour functional website constraint without relying on restricted autonomous code generators.

ideas.pitch: A dashboard web application that traces data flow mutations across backend endpoints and surfaces schema incidents in real-time.
ideas.title: DataLine Web Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Data lineage and incident visualization score exceptionally well with technical judges looking for practical developer tools.

ideas.pitch: A fast web frontend backed by a semantic router that categorizes user natural language queries and directs them to the optimal endpoint.
ideas.title: Semantic Web Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: It implements an efficient, training-free kNN exemplar approach which demonstrates clever architecture over brute-force LLM calls.

ideas.pitch: A secure web application for parsing and standardizing clinical JSON datasets into interoperable formats for medical review.
ideas.title: Clinical Record Web Portal
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting a high-stakes vertical like clinical data processing immediately differentiates the project from generic CRUD apps.

ideas.pitch: A web testing suite where two simulated persona agents interact with the web app interface to uncover edge-case layout and logic bugs.
ideas.title: Adversarial UI Tester
ideas.why_it_could_win: Interactive multi-agent web simulation provides a high-impact demo that stands out during rapid 12-hour judging presentations.
